title: 2024 Bowman Base Chrome Prospect #BCP-115 Josh Rivera - Chicago Cubs Refractor
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Base Chrome Prospect card features Josh Rivera from the Chicago Cubs. The card is part of the MLB set and is a rookie card for Rivera. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Bowman in the United States and is not autographed. 

The card number is BCP-115 and it is a Chrome parallel/variety. The card is not in its original packaging or professionally graded, but the condition type is not specified. This is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection, especially those who follow the Chicago Cubs or are fans of Josh Rivera.
